### What is broken

Opening `/widgets/` shows page not found (404) instead of the widgets page. `/widgets` without the final slash loads correctly.

### Why it is broken

The part that matches web addresses to pages compares the requested address to its known pages character for character. `/widgets/` has one extra final slash, so it matches nothing and falls through to page not found. A local test confirmed this: when the comparison ignored the final slash, `/widgets/` loaded the page (200).

### How to fix it

Remove a final slash from the address before the comparison, so `/widgets/` and `/widgets` both reach the widgets page. The change touches one comparison, plus a test that repeats the failing request to check it stays fixed. Choose hotfix because the change is small and contained.

Two small refinements would make the register even safer: the How to fix it section drops `src/router.ts:88` entirely, yet a reader choosing hotfix will need to open that comparison, so a trailing citation like "...before the comparison (the matcher in the router, `src/router.ts:88`)" would satisfy the only-when-useful rule rather than omitting it; and "loaded the page (200)" leans on a bare status code, so "loaded the page (a 200 success response)" would gloss it on first use the way 404 is glossed in What is broken.
